buildings.name: Flinger

buildings.name: Monster Juicer
buildings.descriptionText: Got some unwanted monsters in your Housing? Want to make space for bigger and better things? Want to make a sacrifice to the Backyard Gods? Then this is the building for you! Recycle Monsters back into Goo with minimal suffering.

buildings.name: Yard Planner
buildings.descriptionText: Quickly move some things around or completely remodel your layout! This building gives you a birds eye view of your Yard and makes moving buildings a snap.

buildings.name: Map Room
buildings.descriptionText: Look around the world, find and help friends and select other players yards to attack.

buildings.name: General Store

buildings.name: Hatchery

buildings.name: Town Hall
buildings.descriptionText: The hub of any great yard and the first building you need to build. Upgrading the Town Hall unlocks new buildings, features and lets you upgrade other buildings to a higher level.

buildings.name: Housing
buildings.descriptionText: Stores the creatures you produce in the Hatchery, upgrade or build more to increase capacity.

buildings.name: Hatchery Control Center
buildings.descriptionText: Control all of your Hatcheries from a single building. You add monsters to one build queue and it sends instructions to whichever Hatchery becomes available first.

buildings.name: Block
buildings.descriptionText: A simple block, use it to build walls to protect buildings and channel attackers into traps or closer to towers. Can be upgraded from wood to stone to metal to gold to black diamond.

buildings.name: Stone Block
buildings.descriptionText: A stronger stone block takes longer to knock down. Protect key buildings from attackers.

buildings.name: Wild Monster Baiter
buildings.descriptionText: Sprays a musk into the air that Wild Monsters can't resist causing them to flock to your base, a great way to test your defenses. If it gets too much for you the building has a siren you can use to scare them off.

buildings.name: Cannon Tower
buildings.descriptionText: Short range but high damage, this towers shells explode on impact, great for taking out tightly-packed groups.

buildings.name: Sniper Tower
buildings.descriptionText: Long range, high damage, but slow to reload. This tower picks off enemy monsters before they even get close. Protect a larger area with this tower.

buildings.name: Monster Bunker

buildings.name: Laser Tower
buildings.descriptionText: Deadly and fast, this plasma energy tower zaps any invading enemy at the speed of light.

buildings.name: Booby Trap
buildings.descriptionText: Invisible to the enemy until it is too late. Triggered when a Monster steps on it, deals large damage to a small area. Place close to buildings or use walls with gaps to group attackers into a small space.

buildings.name: Tesla Tower
buildings.descriptionText: Talk about evil science, this high voltage tower fries any enemy that gets within range. Upgrade to improve number of shocks per charge, damage per shock and range.

buildings.name: Monster Academy
buildings.descriptionText: Through a demanding curriculum of physics, philosophy and physical education, your Monsters will earn their PhD in Advanced Destruction. Failing that, we have a large supply of steroids.

counts.monsterNote: 19 overworld entries including Slimeattikus Mini + 8 Inferno; champions are separate

combat.deployment: Selected produced monsters are put into a capacity-limited Flinger bucket and launched around the clicked valid ground point; overlapping buildings disallows drop. Drop radius varies by bucket size.
combat.pathing: Ground pathfinding and line of sight; flight and burrowing special behavior; target preference fallback; walls can obstruct movement.
combat.towers: Range, damage, fire rate, projectile speed, splash radius, flying/ground eligibility, special individual subclasses.
combat.victory: Varies by map version and target type; wild-monster Town Hall destruction and percentage-damage thresholds are distinct; cannot assume one universal original victory rule.
combat.rating: Source leaderboards sort by outpost/stronghold holdings; zero-start win/loss rating is a requested new system.

parityFeatureGroups: Account registration/login/settings/password reset; saved persistent player yards
